have been going to this surgery for about 24 years, I had mixed service from Dr Anglin, but have had good treatment from Dr Lazin. I'm pleased Dr Anglin retired he never paid attention to hospital letters sent to him.
Dr Lazin is consistent in his care, reads all hospital letters and will correct my repeat prescriptions with new medication without my input, and will change them if they become incorrect, by a telephone call alone.
